method: Independent direct viewing of 9 actual settled-camera Epic MCP editor screenshots, with forced/predicted LOD metadata read and evidence hashes recorded. No UE or Blender calls or runtime asset edits by reviewer.
generation_under_review: First native autogenerated LOD1/LOD2 at measured retained ratios .25/.125, before visual repair. Imported LOD0 preserved.

findings.title: Ivory fragments appear through green waistcoat
findings.evidence: Both lower green waistcoat halves have ivory polygon fragments in LOD1, plus small chest/armhole spots. The larger LOD2 fragments occupy multiple locations beside the apron and under the shoulder mantle. These spots are visible in full-character front/oblique as well as face closeup. The same settled LOD0 cameras do not show these fragments.
findings.mechanism: Layer penetration or atlas/UV damage from skeletal reduction is plausible. Image-only review does not uniquely distinguish geometry contact from UV changes. It is a visible LOD-dependent regression regardless of exact mechanism.
findings.required: Rebuild only generated LODs more conservatively and recapture actual forced/predicted indices. Do not paint over the defect or modify the accepted authored source/LOD0 merely to hide an autogenerated reduction failure.

findings.title: Eyes lose recognizable iris and lid detail
findings.evidence: The LOD2 face closeup shows near-blank pale slits in both eyes and stronger nose/cheek faceting compared with LOD0/LOD1. The green irises and coherent eyelids remain visible at LOD0. LOD2 face identity is degraded.
findings.limit: The forced closeup is a stress view, not proof the game normally chooses LOD2 at conversation distance. Nevertheless it demonstrates a strong simplification loss that needs a conservative generated-LOD policy and appropriate automatic screen thresholds.

findings.title: Stylized anatomy and scene lighting remain simple
findings.evidence: LOD0 has a coherent hair/face/costume with no new severe limb detachment or torso holes in these views. Its face remains smooth/doll-like with simple eye/mouth forms and a darker cheek shadow in the village. No hyperrealistic art quality is claimed.

lod_summaries.0: Recognizable coherent base shape and intact costume. No LOD-dependent white torso fragments. Candidate passes these three actual views with art/evidence limits.
lod_summaries.1: Whole body remains connected and eyes recognizable, but white torso fragments make this generated LOD visually unacceptable in its present form.
lod_summaries.2: Whole body remains connected, but enlarged white torso fragments plus degraded eyes make this generated LOD visually unacceptable in its present form.

temporal_recheck: Settled two-second fixed cameras visibly reduce the earlier widespread stippled/noisy shadow/capture pattern. The reduction-specific torso fragments persist and are absent at settled LOD0, so they cannot be dismissed as the earlier one-frame temporal artifact.

primary_reduction_source.fact: NumOfTrianglesPercentage is retained ratio; BaseLOD selects reduction source; VolumeImportance and lock_edges are reflected reduction settings. Lock edges can retain more triangles than a target.

Native reducer uses triangle ratio, volume preservation, lock edges and bone boundary enforcement. Shading/Texture/Skinning importance scaling is inside a block comment and cannot be relied on as an effective native protection switch. The inspected native block also fixes MaxDist=FLT_MAX (1052), so MaxDeviationPercentage is not a reliable native stopping guard.
ReductionSettings and prioritized section/bone fields are real reflected fields; GetLODInfo itself is still a plain C++ API.
RegenerateLOD is an actual reflected API with bGenerateBaseLOD; passing false preserves imported base regeneration policy.

proposed_next_iteration.rationale: Prefer visible costume/face preservation over the failed actual 25%/12.5% retained ratios. Preserve source LOD0 and the existing four atlas sections. Lock boundaries may cost additional triangles and cannot guarantee nonintersection of layered surfaces. If conservative ratios still fail, use source-verified Face/Cloth section prioritization or separately authored skeletal LODs after architect review.
proposed_next_iteration.write_scope: Only owned generated LOD1/LOD2 reduction settings; actual reflected nested property access/readback must be confirmed by root. Do not replace/copy the noncopyable source model array blindly.
postconditions: Imported LOD0 measured vertices and Skeleton unchanged.
Actual generated LOD1/LOD2 vertex counts remain decreasing and all four sections/material bindings retained.
Capture all three actual LODs after effective editor ticks and confirm predicted index before accepting each image.
No ivory fragments in green outer garment; eyes and visible silhouettes retain recognizable shape at tested views.
Save only the owned skeletal mesh after the visual gate; repeat fresh-process persistence/core/material/LOD verification.

limits: These are static editor-world viewpoints during Idle, not a full gait/deformation cycle or PIE tutorial behavior verification.
No exact runtime triangle count was inferred from render vertex counts.
All model/source changes and engine recovery remain owned by root; reviewer performed evidence/source reading only.

correction_note.fact: Earlier 50%/25% statement was an unverified default assumption. Actual first-reduction readback reports 1/.25/.125. Visual failure is unchanged. Root preserved failed LOD1/2 captures in first-auto-reduction before rebuilding.
